fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable REST API route compression. If this parameter is omitted or set to false, operations are published individually. If set to true, the API is published as a single prefix route. This field is ignored for historical revision publishing, which uses the route mode saved in the historical revision. When set to true, operationDeployments must not be specified because prefix route publishing supports only full publishing
fields.help_zh: 是否开启REST API路由压缩。省略或设置为false时按Operation逐条发布；设置为true时发布为API单条前缀路由。历史版本发布忽略该字段并使用历史版本保存的路由模式。设置为 true 时不得传入 operationDeployments（前缀路由发布仅支持全量发布）
fields.name: enable_route_compression
